title: AlgoCraft: Media Pembelajaran Gamifikasi Berbasis Web & PBL
titleEn: AlgoCraft: Gamified Web-Based PBL Learning Platform
highlight: Platform Utama PTK SMAN 15 Bandung Kelas X-5
highlightEn: Core Action Research Platform at SMAN 15 Bandung Class X-5
deskripsi: Platform web edukasi interaktif berbasis Problem-Based Learning (PBL) yang dirancang khusus untuk memecahkan kesulitan belajar Berpikir Komputasional dan Algoritma murid kelas X-5 SMAN 15 Bandung. Mengusung alur cerita kontekstual 'Petualangan Membangun Kantin Digital Pintar' dengan modul interaktif logika pemrograman, evaluasi kode otomatis, dan sistem pencapaian (badges/XP).
deskripsiEn: An interactive Problem-Based Learning (PBL) educational web platform designed specifically to overcome computational thinking and algorithm learning hurdles for Grade X-5 students at SMAN 15 Bandung. Features a contextual storyline 'Building a Smart Digital Canteen' with interactive logic modules, automated code evaluation, and achievement mechanics (badges/XP).

title: SIDAKAN: IoT Smart Farming & Aquaponics Monitoring
titleEn: SIDAKAN: IoT Smart Farming & Aquaponics System
highlight: Projek Kepemimpinan Gelombang 1 Kelompok A1 UPI
highlightEn: Leadership Project Wave 1 Group A1 UPI
deskripsi: Sistem telemetri cerdas pemantauan akuaponik terintegrasi sensor pH air, suhu lingkungan, kelembaban, dan sensor nutrisi TDS berbasis mikrokontroler Arduino/ESP32. Dilengkapi aktuator otomatis dan dashboard pemantauan kondisi lingkungan budidaya untuk mewujudkan ketahanan pangan ramah lingkungan di lingkungan sekolah dan komunitas binaan.
deskripsiEn: An integrated smart IoT telemetry and monitoring system for aquaponics, equipped with pH, water/ambient temperature, and TDS nutrient sensors using Arduino/ESP32 microcontrollers. Automates aeration/pumping and displays real-time environmental metrics for sustainable school and community agriculture.

title: Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK): Siklus I & II Berpikir Algoritmik
titleEn: Classroom Action Research (CAR): Algorithmic Thinking Cycles I & II
highlightEn: Class X-5 Implementation at SMAN 15 Bandung
deskripsi: Penerapan model Problem-Based Learning yang dikombinasikan dengan diferensiasi proses dan instrumen refleksi berkala. Meneliti transformasi partisipasi aktif murid, reduksi kecemasan koding, dan penguatan 4 pilar Computational Thinking (Dekomposisi, Pengenalan Pola, Abstraksi, dan Perancangan Algoritma) pada materi struktur data dan logika pemrograman.
deskripsiEn: Implementation of Problem-Based Learning combined with process differentiation and structured reflection rubrics. Explores student engagement, coding anxiety reduction, and computational thinking mastery (Decomposition, Pattern Recognition, Abstraction, Algorithm Design).

title: Desain Pembelajaran Berdiferensiasi (Konten, Proses, Produk)
highlight: Pendekatan Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL)
highlightEn: Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL) Approach
deskripsi: Paket perangkat ajar berdiferensiasi lengkap: modul ajar terintegrasi profil pelajar Pancasila, pemetaan gaya belajar audio-visual-kinestetik, LKPD bertingkat (scaffolding), dan instrumen asesmen diagnostik hingga formatif berkelanjutan untuk mata pelajaran Informatika SMA Fase E.
deskripsiEn: Comprehensive differentiated teaching kits: instructional modules aligned with Pancasila student profiles, diagnostic readiness mapping, tiered worksheets (scaffolding), and formative assessment instruments for High School Phase E Informatics.
